name: Bats in the Belfry
summary: Sister Rowland asks you to clear bats from Farholde Cathedral. She hopes the church will serve the Light again when the fighting ends.

sections.title: The Cathedral
sections.body: Sister Rowland asks for your help at Farholde Cathedral, where dusk bats roost in the upper stories. She and brother Lowley now serve Farholde in a more secular capacity, and the church has fallen into disuse. Rowland wants to keep it in working order, though she fears the fighting may last a long while.

faq.q: Why are there bats in the cathedral?
faq.answer: A colony of bats has made its roost in the upper stories of Farholde Cathedral.

faq.q: Who asks me to clear the bats?
faq.answer: Sister Rowland asks you to remove the roosting bats from Farholde Cathedral.

faq.q: Why does Sister Rowland want the church kept in working order?
faq.answer: Sister Rowland hopes the Light can return to the church once the fighting ends.
The church has fallen into disuse since Sister Rowland and brother Lowley began serving Farholde in a more secular capacity.
